title: Notice regarding non-availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai from 03.11.2026 to 06.11.2026 and on 23.11.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 02/11/2026
It is hereby notified that from 03.11.2026 to
06.11.2026 and on 23.11.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 02/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-05/2026
It is hereby notified that from 03.11.2026 to
06.11.2026 and on 23.11.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai would
not be available for Judicial and administrative work.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta
K. Vishen and Hon’ble Mr. Justice P. M. Raval) would
take up the matters notified in the Cause list of Hon’ble
Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen
and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai.)
(3) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Aniruddha
P. Mayee) would take up the matters notified in the
Cause List of Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr.
Justice P. M. Raval.)
By Order of Hon’ble Acting The Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
